name: Windows Rule : Nightmare Eclipse ShieldBreak
description: This rule is for the detection of Nightmare Eclipse ShieldBreak exploit.
author: Johann Weingertner
query:
sequence by host.id, process.entity_id with maxspan=2m
  [any where event.code == "11" and file.path : "C:\\*\\BERLIN:stream"]
  [any where event.code == "7" and dll.path : "C:\\*\\MpClient.dll"]
  [any where event.code == "10" and winlog.event_data.TargetImage : "C:\\*\\MsMpEng.exe"]
  [any where event.code == "7" and dll.path : "C:\\Windows\\System32\\phoneinfo.dll:stream"]
  [any where event.code == "7" and dll.path : "*\\taskschd.dll"]
  [any where event.code == "11" and file.path : "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\\WER\\ReportQueue\\*\\Report.wer"]
  [any where event.code == "23" and file.path : "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\\WER\\ReportQueue\\*\\Report.wer"]
